title: Feral (bear) druid: growls a mob off the healer or a DPS player, mauls, and holds Dire Bear Form

rules.desc: A mob that hits the healer (extra1) or the DPS player gets Growl from the bear on that mob within 5 s, at least 70 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 12 s, one counted answer per 10 s: Growl's cooldown)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:55-57 (lose aggro -> growl at ACTION_MOVE), :61-63 (party member attacked -> growl on attacker at ACTION_MOVE); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidAiObjectContext.cpp:308-309 (growl, growl on attacker); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: both bear taunt rows sit at ACTION_MOVE, far below the warrior's INTERRUPT+1, so anything in the HIGH band wins the tick first; whether a growl answers most pulls is the question. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: The bear casts Maul at least 4 times per minute of scored fight time
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:73-75 (maul rage available -> maul at ACTION_NORMAL + 1); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidAiObjectContext.cpp:283 (maul rage available, kBearMaulMinRage); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: maul has its own row gated only on rage, and a bear being hit earns rage every swing; it should fire whenever affordable. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: The bear holds Bear Form or Dire Bear Form (aura 5487 or 9634) for at least 90 percent of its in-combat samples
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidTriggers.h:207-212 (BearFormTrigger: not in bear or dire bear form); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:273-276 (bear form -> dire bear form at ACTION_MOVE + 9); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the buff row re-shifts the bear on the next tick whenever the form drops; nothing in the fight removes it. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
